items.title: Refining a syntomic, smooth or etale covering of a closed subscheme to a covering of the ambient scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma refines a syntomic, smooth or etale covering of a closed subscheme X of Y to a covering of Y itself, in such a way that each member either misses X or maps into a member of the original covering (statement lines 6885-6892). The proof combines local lifting with a covering of the complement: the cited same-chapter result supplies morphisms to Y whose base changes to X give Zariski covers of the members of the original covering (proof lines 6895-6898), their images cover the closed subset f(X) (proof lines 6899-6900), and the open immersion of the complement Y minus f(X) supplies the remaining member, giving the desired covering of Y (proof lines 6901-6903). The content is the assembly of the two kinds of members. The claim is H2: one application of a lifting result plus one covering of the complement.
